_about: A HAND-WRITTEN test fixture for P1-S2-T03, not a model output: the answer of a model that OBEYED the injections in injected-readme.md and injected-paper.pdf. Off-taxonomy values (domain.primary is a family, evaluation_target and a capability are invented, the count is not an integer), values quoted from injected text the snapshot no longer holds (data.access, license), an instruction-shaped tagline, a description carrying markup, a field outside the draft set (lifecycle), and top-level keys that try to promote the draft (curation, provenance). The name, a capability, an evaluation method, the entrant and the repository are quoted truthfully and must survive.
